module: GE extension `core_input_bindings`: loads, merges, saves and sends to the engine the key/axis -> action associations (bindings) of all connected devices, for each player. It reads the default inputmaps (JSON of the game and the vehicles) then the user differences (*.diff in settings/inputmaps), applies the FFB response curves, notifies the UI, the engine, the vehicles (force feedback config) and the other extensions. It also handles the activation of menu ActionMaps according to the open screens. A modder mainly uses it to find the key of an action, reset the controls or enable/disable menu actions.
usage:
local ctrl = core_input_bindings.getControlForAction('accelerate')   -- e.g. 'axis1'
local others = core_input_bindings.getActionsSharingControls('toggleMenues')
core_input_bindings.setMenuActionsEnabled({menu_item_up = false, menu_item_down = false})
notes: Structure of M.bindings: list of {devname, contents = {bindings = {...}, guid, vidpid, name, devicetype, …}} sorted by device name (wheel0 before xinput0). Each binding: action (unique name, prefixed by the vehicle if specific), control, player, unused (boolean), plus the normalized fields (deadzoneResting, deadzoneEnd, linearity, angle, lockType, filterType, isInverted, isForceEnabled, ffb{…}).

Default values of the binding fields (fillNormalizeBindingDefaults): deadzoneResting 0, deadzoneEnd 0, linearity 1, filterType -1, angle 0, lockType 3, ffb.forceCoef 100, ffb.smoothing 150, ffb.softlockForce 0.5 (clamped 0..1), ffb.responseCurve {{0,0},{1,1}}, logitechVibrotactileFreqMax clamped 20..150 (default 50).

Files: default bindings = JSON in settings/inputmaps (game), vehicles/<vehicle>/ and vehicles/<vehicle>/inputmaps; user settings = .diff files written under settings/inputmaps[/<vehicle>] (name '<devicetype>.diff' for keyboard/mouse, otherwise '<lowercase vidpid>.diff'). A diff contains 'bindings' (added/modified) and 'removed'; version 1 allows control duplicates.
File changes (inputmaps, actions) trigger a deferred reload of 0.1 s (forceRefresh) processed in updateGFX.
Players: assignedPlayers associates a device name with a player index (-1 = none). With autoAssignPlayersToDevices (true by default) the association is recomputed by core_multiseat.
Menus: the menu ActionMaps are 'MenuActionMap' plus 'MenuIndependent_<action>ActionMap'; they activate when a non-gameplay UI route (other than play, multiseat, trackBuilder) or a popup is open.

Emitted hooks: onInputBindingsChanged(assignedPlayers), onFFBConfigChanged, onMenuActionMapEnabled(enabled). UI events: InputBindingsChanged, AssignedPlayersChanged, MenuActionMapEnabled, MenuActionMapStateChanged(action, enabled), RecentDevicesChanged, ControllersChanged.

Inconsistencies: menuActive is deprecated (logs an error with the call stack then calls setMenuActionMapEnabled); the error messages of setMenuActionEnabled format a boolean/nil with %q which can raise an error instead of being displayed; migrateScePadDiffFiles does ipairs on the content of settings/scePadGuids.json without a nil check; onVehicleSpawned recomputes the bindings but does not call notifyAll; the ImGui debug window for ActionMaps is entirely commented out in the file.
Field exported but not initialized as expected: isMenuActive starts at false and is only modified by setMenuActionMapEnabled.

isMenuActive.desc: true when the menu ActionMap is active (menu screen or popup open).

autoAssignPlayersToDevices.desc: true (default): the player<->device assignment is computed automatically by core_multiseat.

devices.desc: Connected devices: name (e.g. 'xinput0') -> {guid, productName, vidpid, playerNumber, platformUserNumber}.

defaultBindings.desc: Official default bindings, same structure as bindings; used as a reference to compute the diffs.

getControlForAction.desc: Returns the first control (key/axis) found for an action, across all devices. The result is cached until the next notifyGE.

getActionsSharingControls.desc: Other actions used (not 'unused') on the same controls as actionName, on the same device.

notifyUI.desc: Sends to the UI the controllers, the assigned players and an InputBindingsChanged packet (categories, current vehicle's actions, binding template, bindings, defaultBindings, reason).

saveBindingsToDisk.desc: Saves the bindings sent by the UI: splits them by vehicle/generic, compares to the default version and writes a .diff file per device and vehicle, then forces a reload.

data.desc: Complete inputmap of a device: {bindings, devicetype, guid, name, vidpid, …}.

resetBindings.desc: Deletes the custom bindings (user inputmaps/diff) of a device or of all, generic and of the player vehicle, and reloads.

desiredDevName.desc: Device name; nil = all connected devices.

setPlayerToDevice.desc: Assigns a player to a device (assignPlayerToDevice), recomputes the bindings and notifies everyone.

applyPlayerAssignments.desc: Applies an assignment table at once (device -> player; absent = -1).

returns.desc: false if assignments is not a table.

refreshAssignedPlayers.desc: Recomputes the automatic assignment via core_multiseat (if autoAssign) and only notifies if it changed.

getFFBConfigForAction.desc: Reads the force feedback configuration of an action (steering, accelerate, brake) for a vehicle's driver: decodes the JSON returned by be:getFFBConfig then ffbParamsJson into ffbConfig.ffbParams.

returns.desc: FFB config, nil if there is no driver or FFB controller or on a decoding error.

setMenuActionMapEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the main menu ActionMap (and, on disabling, all independent menu ActionMaps), updates isMenuActive and notifies the UI/extensions.

setMenuActionEnabled.desc: Enables or disables a menu ActionMap: either by action name ('menu_item_up' -> MenuIndependent_menu_item_upActionMap), or directly by ActionMap name. Refuses (error log) ActionMaps not related to menus or unknown.

actionName.desc: Action name; can be nil if actionMapName is given.

returns.desc: New effective state (am.enabled), nil on failure.

setMenuActionsEnabled.desc: Applies in batch a state for several menu actions: {menu_item_up = true, menu_item_down = false}. Ignores non-boolean values.

returns.desc: Action -> effective state; false if the argument is not a table.

getMenuActionStates.desc: Current state (enabled or not) of each independent menu action.

setMenuActionMapWatchEnabled.desc: Enables/disables the UI notification MenuActionMapStateChanged on every modification of a menu ActionMap.

setMenuScrollActionMapEnabled.desc: Pushes or pops the 'MenuScrollActionMap' on the ActionMap stack.

returns.desc: Resulting state; false if the ActionMap does not exist.

isModalPopupOpen.desc: Indicates whether a modal popup is open (UI state '/popup/...' other than '/popup/activity/').

menuActive.desc: Deprecated: logs an error with the call stack and calls setMenuActionMapEnabled(enabled).

getUsedBindingsFiles.desc: Reloads the bindings while recording the file paths read (useful to list the inputmaps used).

enableCustomModifier.desc: Enables or disables a custom modifier of the ActionMap for a player (ActionMap.enableCustomModifier).

getRecentDevices.desc: List of devices sorted by recent activity (cached, getDevicesByRecentActivity).

onFirstUpdate.desc: Hook at first update: lists the devices, assigns the players, computes all bindings and notifies.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook on load: runs the migrations (v37 layout popup; conversion of PlayStation controller diffs before 0.38).

onDeviceChanged.desc: Hook when a device is plugged/unplugged: updates the list (with UI toasts), the assignments and notifies everyone.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Settings change hook: if the 'multiseat' setting changed, recomputes assignments and bindings.

onFileChanged.desc: File change hook: if an actions or inputmap file (settings/inputmaps, vehicles/.../inputmaps, *.inputmap.json) changes, schedules a reload in 0.1 s.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook on a player's vehicle change: recomputes assignments and bindings (the specific actions change) and notifies everyone.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook on vehicle creation: recomputes assignments and bindings without notification.

onPlayerVehiclePresenceChanged.desc: Hook when a player enters or leaves a vehicle: sends the force feedback config back to the vehicles.

updateGFX.desc: Per-frame hook: runs the deferred bindings reload; disables the 'VehicleSpecificActionMap' when the player is walking (unicycle in world camera) outside split-screen.

onAfterRouteChange.desc: UI route change hook: stores the route name and updates the menu ActionMap state.

onUIStateTriggered.desc: UI state change hook: detects open popups ('/popup/...') and updates the menu ActionMap.

onUIInitialised.desc: Hook on UI initialization: resets the modal popup state to false.

onRecentDevicesChanged.desc: Hook called when the device activity order changes: caches and sends RecentDevicesChanged to the UI.
